# Final narrow verification: R1-R3

**Evidence re-run this turn, before reading anything** ? `probe-baseline.mjs` exit 0 `BASELINE_EVIDENCE_VERIFIED`; `verify-artifacts.mjs` exit 0 `PLAN_ARTIFACTS_VERIFIED`; `git status` shows only `?? docs/crucible-20260907/`, so no application file was touched.

## R1 ? P00 instruction coverage ? RESOLVED

PLAN.md:46 now reads "rewrite **every** CLAUDE.md section stating status, stack, scope, roadmap, budget or metrics", replacing the four-section enumeration. That reaches `## Core Value Propositions`, `## Development Roadmap`, `## Key Architecture Patterns`, `## Critical Implementation Notes` and `## Success Metrics Targets`, which were the sections my finding named.

The canary is widened correctly and can still fail: it "must detect instructions to build flyer generation, QR referrals, native apps, Meilisearch, GCP or NestJS" ? no longer stack-only. The added clause "while allowing clearly labelled historical or out-of-scope references" does not defang it; it exempts *references* (needed so the control does not fire on PLAN.md:174's own out-of-scope list) while still requiring detection of *instructions to build*.

## R2 ? Railway environment paragraph ? RESOLVED

PLAN.md:192 now matches the tool behavior I verified against the IaC docs last round (one file per repository, environment selected at execution time): "One .railway/railway.ts per repository defines an environment-neutral resource structure. Environment-specific values come from Railway environment variables and variable references, not literal staging credentials, URLs or domains in the shared file. CI selects the target environment at plan/apply time with that environment's token."

It carries a failable acceptance rather than an assertion: plan the same file against staging then production and prove no unintended variable, domain or resource change, **"an injected staging URL literal must fail the control."** That is a positive control, which is what the omit-means-delete risk needed.

The leftover "one project-level .railway/railway.ts configuration" sentence is gone, replaced by "Keep service-specific build/start settings distinct within that shared definition." No contradiction with PLAN.md:205's "service-specific settings remain distinct within the single project definition" or with PLAN.md:200's per-environment origins/URLs/webhooks, since those values are now routed to environment variables.

## R3 ? Unknown-price rule and P02 controls ? RESOLVED

PLAN.md:40 now reads "Missing date/location/status/**price** is unknown, not fabricated. A quarantined-unit event is labelled price-unknown and excluded from price-bounded discovery filters; it never matches free or under-budget filters. P02 acceptance includes unknown-price, genuinely free and known paid events as controls."

The genuinely-free control is the right addition ? it is what separates "unknown" from "0.00" and stops a quarantined row from silently passing a free-events filter, which was the failure mode I described.

The rule and its P02 acceptance directive live once, at :40, rather than being copied into P02's own paragraph at :72. That is the correct call: one authoritative statement cannot drift from a duplicate, and P02:72 still carries the quarantine rule it needs locally.

## No new contradictions; prior coverage intact

Edits are localized (PLAN.md 209 ? 210 lines). I confirmed the earlier corrections are still in place and unaltered: per-phase ledger path (:21), P08 age attestation in the data row (:38), the additive `price_minor` money transition (P01), the CLAUDE.md ownership move (:46), P06 unentitled-agent entitlement/privacy acceptance (:124), and the Supabase CLI migration authority (:198). G2 passing confirms every local evidence link still resolves and all artifacts remain ASCII and parseable.

## Verdict

**READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.** All three minor corrections are confirmed in place with failable controls, no new contradiction was introduced, and the prior full-plan coverage is preserved.

Scope unchanged from the last round: this approves the plan and its evidence trail only. The application is not complete and is not certified working ? every P00-P10 acceptance contract is still a future check with no run behind it, and no live Railway project, GitHub connection, migration, payment, model call, source crawl or worker cycle has been observed.

FINAL_REVISED_PLAN_AUDIT_COMPLETE
